title: Landing page loads and hero section is visible
description: Verify the public landing page renders with the hero heading visible
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000
Assert page title contains 'DevReview AI' or similar text
Assert the hero section heading is visible on screen

title: Landing page navigation links are present
description: Verify Sign In link and CTA button are visible in the header
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000
Assert Sign In link is visible in the header
Assert a Get Started or Sign Up CTA button is visible

title: Landing page stats section is displayed
description: Verify the stats section with numeric metrics renders on scroll
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000
Scroll down to the stats section
Assert at least one numeric statistic is visible

title: Sign-in page renders all form fields
description: Verify the sign-in page renders email, password fields and Sign In button
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Assert the email input field is visible
Assert the password input field is visible
Assert the Sign In submit button is visible

title: Sign-in empty form submission shows validation errors
description: Verify inline validation errors appear when the sign-in form is submitted empty
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Click the Sign In button without filling any fields
Assert an error message for the email field appears
Assert an error message for the password field appears

title: Sign-in invalid email format shows validation error
description: Verify that entering a malformed email triggers a validation error
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Type 'notanemail' in the email field
Type 'somepassword' in the password field
Click the Sign In button
Assert an email format validation error is shown

title: Sign-in password visibility toggle works
description: Verify that clicking the eye icon toggles password field visibility
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Type a password in the password field
Click the eye icon button to reveal the password
Assert the password input type changes to 'text'
Click the eye-off icon button to hide the password
Assert the password input type is 'password' again

title: Sign-in page Sign Up link navigates to registration
description: Verify that the Sign Up link on the sign-in page navigates to /sign-up
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Click the 'Sign up' link
Assert the URL is http://localhost:3000/sign-up

title: Sign-in GitHub OAuth button is rendered and enabled
description: Verify the 'Sign in with GitHub' button exists and is not disabled on initial load
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Assert the 'Sign in with GitHub' button is visible
Assert the button is not in a disabled state on initial load

title: Sign-up page renders all form fields
description: Verify the sign-up page renders name, email, password fields and submit button
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-up
Assert the name input field is visible
Assert the email input field is visible
Assert the password input field is visible
Assert the Sign Up submit button is visible

title: Sign-up empty form submission shows validation errors
description: Verify validation errors appear when the registration form is submitted empty
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-up
Click the submit button without filling any fields
Assert at least one validation error message appears on screen

title: Sign-up page Sign In link navigates to sign-in
description: Verify that the Sign In link on the sign-up page navigates to /sign-in
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-up
Click the 'Sign in' link
Assert the URL is http://localhost:3000/sign-in

title: Protected /repo route redirects unauthenticated users
description: Verify that accessing /repo without a session redirects to /sign-in
steps: Ensure no active session cookie is present
Navigate to http://localhost:3000/repo
Assert the URL has redirected to /sign-in

title: Custom 404 page renders for unknown routes
description: Verify that navigating to a non-existent path shows the custom not-found page
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/this-page-does-not-exist-xyz-12345
Assert a 404 or 'not found' message is visible on the page

title: Landing page uses dark theme by default
description: Verify the landing page root element has the dark theme class applied
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000
Assert the root element has CSS class 'dark' or a dark background colour is applied

title: Full email sign-up flow redirects to /repo
description: Register a brand-new account with valid credentials and verify redirect to the repositories dashboard
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-up
Fill in Name field with 'Test User'
Fill in Email field with a unique valid email e.g. testuser_unique@example.com
Fill in Password field with 'TestPass123!'
Fill in Confirm Password field with 'TestPass123!'
Click the Sign Up button
Assert the URL redirects to http://localhost:3000/repo

title: Sign-up password shorter than 8 characters shows error
description: Verify that a password with fewer than 8 characters triggers a validation error
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-up
Fill in Name with 'Test'
Fill in Email with 'test@example.com'
Fill in Password with 'abc' (fewer than 8 characters)
Fill in Confirm Password with 'abc'
Click Sign Up
Assert an error 'Password must be at least 8 characters' is shown

title: Sign-up mismatched passwords shows confirmation error
description: Verify that entering different values in Password and Confirm Password shows an error
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-up
Fill in Name with 'Test'
Fill in Email with 'test@example.com'
Fill in Password with 'TestPass123!'
Fill in Confirm Password with 'DifferentPass!'
Click Sign Up
Assert a 'Passwords do not match' error is displayed

title: Sign-up password strength indicator appears while typing
description: Verify the password strength bar changes label as password complexity increases
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-up
Type 'abc' in the Password field
Assert a 'Weak' strength label is visible
Clear the password field and type 'TestPass123!'
Assert the strength label changes to 'Strong' or 'Very Strong'

title: Full email sign-in flow redirects to /repo
description: Authenticate with valid credentials and confirm redirect to the repositories dashboard
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in Email with the test account email from loginUser config
Fill in Password with the test account password from loginPassword config
Click Sign In
Assert the URL redirects to http://localhost:3000/repo

title: Sign-in with wrong password shows error message
description: Verify that an incorrect password shows a sign-in error banner
steps: Navigate to http://localhost:3000/sign-in
Fill in Email with a valid account email
Fill in Password with 'WrongPassword999!'
Click Sign In
Assert an error banner appears above the form

title: Dashboard header is visible after login
description: After login, verify the main navigation header renders with all nav links
steps: Log in with valid credentials and navigate to http://localhost:3000/repo
Assert the header navigation is visible
Assert 'Repositories' nav link is present
Assert 'Reviews' nav link is present
Assert 'Teams' nav link is present
Assert 'Analytics' nav link is present

title: User menu is accessible in the dashboard header
description: Verify the user avatar / menu button is rendered in the header after login
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/repo
Assert the user avatar or user menu button is visible in the top-right of the header
Click the user menu button
Assert a dropdown menu with Profile, Settings, and Sign Out options appears

title: Repositories page renders empty state with Connect button
description: For a newly registered user, verify the /repo page shows an empty state with a Connect Repository button
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/repo
Assert the page heading 'Repositories' or similar is visible
Assert a 'Connect Repository' or 'Add Repository' button is present on the page

title: Connect Repository panel opens on button click
description: Clicking the Connect Repository button opens a GitHub repository selector panel
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/repo
Click the 'Connect Repository' button
Assert a panel, drawer, or dialog appears listing GitHub repositories to connect

title: Reviews page renders with filters and search
description: Verify the /reviews page loads with status filter tabs and a search input
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/reviews
Assert the page heading 'Reviews' or similar is visible
Assert at least one status filter tab (All, Completed, Pending) is visible
Assert a search input field is present

title: Reviews page list/grid view toggle works
description: Verify the view mode can be switched between list and grid
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/reviews
Assert a list view icon button is visible
Assert a grid view icon button is visible
Click the grid view button
Assert the layout changes to a grid display

title: Analytics page renders key metrics section
description: Verify the /analytics page loads with metrics cards and charts
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/analytics
Assert the page heading 'Analytics' or similar is visible
Assert at least one key metric card (Total Reviews, Approval Rate, etc.) is visible

title: Analytics time period filter changes data range
description: Verify that changing the time period selector updates the displayed analytics range
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/analytics
Assert a time period selector (7d, 30d, 90d, etc.) is visible
Click a different time period option
Assert the page reflects the updated time period selection

title: Teams page renders with Create Team button
description: Verify the /teams page loads with a Create Team button
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/teams
Assert the page heading 'Teams' is visible
Assert the 'Create Team' button is present

title: Create Team dialog opens and accepts a team name
description: Verify clicking Create Team opens a dialog with a team name input
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/teams
Click 'Create Team' button
Assert a dialog or modal opens
Assert a text input for the team name is visible in the dialog

title: Settings page renders all setting sections
description: Verify the /settings page loads with theme, preferences, and sessions sections
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/settings
Assert the page heading 'Settings' or similar is visible
Assert a theme selector section is visible
Assert a sessions section listing active sessions is visible

title: Settings theme selector switches between light and dark
description: Verify the theme can be toggled to light or dark from the settings page
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/settings
Find the theme selector in the Appearance or Preferences section
Click 'Light' theme option
Assert the page background switches to a light colour
Click 'Dark' theme option
Assert the page background switches back to dark

title: Sign out from user menu redirects to landing page
description: Clicking Sign Out in the user menu signs the user out and redirects to /
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/repo
Click the user menu button in the header
Click 'Sign Out' from the dropdown
Assert the URL redirects to http://localhost:3000 or http://localhost:3000/sign-in

title: Accessing protected route after sign-out redirects to sign-in
description: After signing out, navigating directly to a protected page redirects to /sign-in
steps: Log in, then sign out from the user menu
Navigate directly to http://localhost:3000/repo
Assert the URL redirects to http://localhost:3000/sign-in

title: Profile page renders user information
description: Verify the /profile page loads and displays the current user's name and email
steps: Log in and navigate to http://localhost:3000/profile
Assert a section showing user display name is visible
Assert the user's email is displayed or editable
